title: Setup SSL Certificates with Let's Encrypt — Companion Resources
title_es: Configurar certificados SSL con Let's Encrypt — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable Let's Encrypt setup: docker-compose with nginx + certbot, an nginx.conf ready for the ACME challenge, a Cloudflare credentials template, and a cert-manager ClusterIssuer/Ingress example.
description_es: Setup ejecutable de Let's Encrypt: docker-compose con nginx + certbot, un nginx.conf listo para el desafío ACME, una plantilla de credenciales de Cloudflare y un ejemplo de ClusterIssuer/Ingress de cert-manager.
